extraction.notes: Reconciliation starts from net income (loss) of $(6,924)K, which differs from the $(6,897)K net income attributable to common stockholders in the financial summary; the reconciliation is used as printed. The 'Gain on sales of real estate' and 'Loss on extinguishment of debt and modification costs' lines show a dash (zero) for Q1 2025; the prior-year amounts were excluded. Diluted share count 25,576 (printed in thousands, footnote 2) reproduces FFO $0.68, Core FFO $0.75, and AFFO $0.84 per share. AFFO does not deduct recurring capex, so recurring capex is taken from the Historical Capital Expenditures table on page 17 ($2,797K, quarter). Its scope is not explicitly labeled as company share vs. total; recorded as company total as presented.
